==Gameplay Notes==
* {{itm|Cidala}} must be level 100 to swap to this style.
* Shares a [[Cross-Fate Episode]] with [[Catura]] and another with [[Makura]].
** Gains +540 ATK after completing one [[Cross-Fate Episode]] and +180 HP after completing the second, regardless of order.
===Ascending Fur-tune===
{{AssassinBuff|{{status|ATK Sharply Boosted (Can't be extended)|a=50%|t=1.5T|m=ass}}}}

===Luck Goes Up===
*{{status|Luck Goes Up|t=2T}} grants the following effects:<ref name="GameWith" />
**30% Bonus Earth DMG effect
**[[Double Strike]] effect
**Counters with the max number of hits

===Luck Goes Down===
*{{status|Luck Goes Down 5|t=5T|acc=200%}} has the following effects:<ref name="GameWith" />
**25% DEF Down
**Supplemental DMG Taken effect (Damage cap: 30,000)
**'''For every 20,220,000 Earth normal attack damage dealt to this foe:''' Deal 2,022,000 Plain damage. Inflict {{status|DMG Taken Amplified 1|a=20%|t=1T|n=22|acc=}}.

===Divine Tiger United===
*In a 4-man party with default hostility, the probability that Cidala gets targeted is ~40%.

===Extended Mastery Support Skill===
*{{verify|1% boost to triple attack rate per debuff.}}
**Each rank increases the maximum triple attack rate boost, but not the boost per debuff.
